Proposition
[Euclidean isoperimetric inequality] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0180 1. ch21:21.1\group Pseudolocality hypotheses

For every regular domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb E^n$, \[ \Area (\partial \Omega )^n\ge n^n\omega _n\, \Vol (\Omega )^{n-1}=c_n\Vol (\Omega )^{n-1}. \]
